title: Queen of Soul
description: Choosing the right tense inside a continuous biographical text: present simple for what is still true, simple past for a finished event tied to a past time, present perfect for a career report (never, already, so far, yet, since and for) and why a finished date rules the present perfect out; the language of opinion — asking (What do you think of...?, How do you feel about...?, Would you like...?), giving (I think / believe that..., In my opinion..., I'm (not) sure / certain that...), agreeing (I agree with you, That's true) and disagreeing politely (I don't agree, I'm afraid I can't agree), with the 'I am agree' trap and think of versus think about; and the reading skills of the lesson — building an identity card from the text (name, real name, place of birth, place of residence, marital status, occupation, major records), judging a statement true or false with a justification quoted from the text, and choosing a title that carries the main idea; vocabulary of success and fame (a successful career, a large fortune, becoming famous, achieving an ambition, starting a business, earning a lot of money, university studies, a brilliant future, publicity, the press)
